description: Pin a package to its latest version, or a given versionId, on your webmcp.today account — creates the pin if absent, moves it if present (also how rollback works: pass an older versionId). This does not install into your browser; the extension's installs are local to the browser. Returns a link that installs this exact version there. Requires an API key.

versionId.description: Pin to this version instead of latest

name: install_package
